sentences.en: In this store, we take items on consignment. We only pay you after someone buys them.
sentences.zh: 在这个商店里，我们接受代销商品。只有当有人购买后我们才会支付给你。

sentences.en: He shipped the consignment to his warehouse in New York.
sentences.zh: 他把这批货物发运到了纽约的仓库。

sentences.en: The antique dealer received a consignment of rare books yesterday.
sentences.zh: 这家古董商昨天收到了一批稀有书籍。

senses.zh: 托付货物;托卖货物; 寄售;托运;托付;交付; 以寄售方式
